rooms.name: Road Junction
rooms.desc: A fork in the Old Svalich Road: a lane climbs north over rocky ground to a walled village, and a bell tolls from an abbey high on the mountain.
rooms.dm: West, the road runs a little over a mile into the mists. North, the path climbs to the gatehouse (S2).

rooms.name: Gatehouse
rooms.desc: A gate of two slate-capped towers and an arch carved with the village's name; heavy banded doors, and nervous fur-hatted spearmen on the walls.
rooms.dm: Two archers (scouts) in the towers, four guards on the walls; the alarm brings 4 more guards and 40 commoners with handaxes in five rounds. One guard per 300 ft of wall elsewhere. Dmitri Krezkov comes to the gate.

rooms.name: Village of Krezk
rooms.desc: Log cottages with thatch and stone chimneys strung along dirt lanes in a near-forest of pines; grey cliffs and the abbey road loom to the north-east.
rooms.dm: A commune: no inns, no trade. Chores earn a bed. The burgomaster's cottage is the largest, nearest the gate; every cottage has its family graves, the last decade's caskets emptied by the Abbot's gravediggers.

rooms.name: Pool and Shrine
rooms.desc: A bright spring-fed pool and, on its bank, a tottering gazebo sheltering a faded wooden figure with open arms.
rooms.dm: Blessed by Saint Markovia: the first drink gives the benefit of lesser restoration. The Morninglord faces east. The Shrine of the White Sun.

rooms.name: Winding Road
rooms.desc: A narrow road of loose scree zigzagging up the cliff face.
rooms.dm: It climbs 400 ft, doubling back twice, to the north gate (S6); slow and treacherous, colder near the top.

rooms.name: Burgomaster's Cottage: Hall
rooms.desc: The burgomaster's hall: a stone hearth against the bedchamber wall, a long table between benches, shelves of stores, a trapdoor in the floor.
rooms.dm: Dmitri and Anna Krezkov. The trapdoor opens on the wine cellar, empty. Chores earn a bed here.

rooms.name: Burgomaster's Cottage: Bedchamber
rooms.desc: A plain bedchamber behind the hearth wall: a bed, a trunk, a wardrobe.
rooms.dm: The Krezkovs sleep here; Ilya's things are still in the trunk.

rooms.name: Burgomaster's Cottage: Pens and Coops
rooms.desc: Pens of pigs and stacked coops of chickens in straw, kept indoors against the cold; a wide back door.
rooms.dm: Lots of room for animals; the back door opens on the family graveyard.

objects.label: The gatehouse: two towers, twelve-foot ironbound doors barred from inside (DC 15 Str to lift the bar; a siege engine to break them)
A trapdoor to the wine cellar: empty (the wine from the Wizard of Wines is long overdue)
Pigpens and chicken coops kept indoors against the cold.
Burgomaster Dmitri Krezkov (noble): grieving his son Ilya; hospitality only for those who help Krezk (the overdue wine)
Anna Krezkova (noble), fearless
The Krezkov graveyard: four children; several caskets emptied by the Abbot's gravediggers. Ilya's plot (the last) is fresh, buried four days ago, undisturbed.
A card-reading treasure lies under the gazebo: it must be torn down, and the villagers take it ill (disadvantage on Charisma checks with them until it is repaired)
Krezkite villagers (commoners) at their chores

rooms.name: Archer's Post (west tower)
rooms.desc: The archer's post atop the west tower: a stone room under the peaked roof, an arrow slit six inches wide toward the road, an open doorway onto the wall-walk.
rooms.dm: One archer (scout). The slit gives the archer cover; the doorway leads to the parapet.

rooms.name: Archer's Post (east tower)
rooms.desc: The archer's post atop the east tower, the same as its twin: an arrow slit toward the road, an open doorway onto the wall-walk.
rooms.dm: One archer (scout).

rooms.name: Wall-walk (south-east)
rooms.desc: The wall-walk (south-east): five feet of stone behind a battlemented parapet, twenty feet above the ground, a wooden ladder down inside.
rooms.dm: A lone guard watches each 300 ft of wall and sounds the alarm at any sign of danger; five rounds later every able-bodied adult is at the gate.

rooms.name: North Gate
rooms.desc: Two stone guard huts and a pair of rusty iron gates in a low rubble wall; beyond, the abbey with its belfry and a smoking chimney.
rooms.dm: Otto and Zygfrek Belview asleep under furs (DC 12 Stealth to climb the wall without waking them; opening the gates wakes them). Open the abbey's map.

rooms.name: Graveyard
rooms.desc: Old headstones of priests and nuns among stunted pines and thin snow; past the low wall, a sheer drop to the village.
rooms.dm: The sun's grave (X) holds a ring of regeneration for Tasha Petrovna's holy symbol. Open the abbey's map.

rooms.name: Garden Gatehouse
rooms.desc: A small gatehouse at the entrance to the abbey's gardens.
rooms.dm: Empty.

rooms.name: Gardens
rooms.desc: Four walled vegetable beds on a shelf of the cliff, rabbits among the turnips and two sack-headed scarecrows on crosses; the east wing's broken windows stare down.
rooms.dm: The door into S15 is not locked. A card-reading treasure in the southernmost scarecrow wakes seven wights.

objects.label: Otto Belview (LE mongrelfolk, standing leap), asleep under furs; squats, brays when he laughs, and thinks himself the finest creature alive
Zygfrek Belview (LE mongrelfolk, darkvision), asleep under furs; scaled on one side, furred on the other, and sure everyone is judging her
The Abbey of Saint Markovia (S10-S24): open the abbey's own map from S6-S9.
